scope: Lead-owned bounded scientific follow-up under the existing matrix-biology reservation; no shared queue or other worker edits
trigger: Primary GEO GSE6481 series metadata contradicts PeerJ21497's description of 19 EMC versus 128 other chondrosarcomas; all sample metadata fetched read-only showed actual soft-tissue categories. Expression values have not been inspected for this follow-up.
question: Does the published H1FX EMC-lineage interpretation survive source identity verification and a targeted comparison in authenticated EMC tissue expression data?
original_claim: PeerJ21497 describes H1FX as a lineage-specific feature and candidate epigenetic hallmark based partly on GSE6481 P=0.001. It already acknowledges prognostic overfitting and lacks outcome validation; those existing limitations are not new findings here.
hypotheses: The reported accession could be a typo and a different valid source may support the comparison
The named source cannot provide EMC validation
H1FX may still be EMC-enriched in authenticated independent measurements despite the source mismatch

prospective_analysis.focus: H1FX is primary; PXN and TYMS are companion context, not adaptive replacements
prospective_analysis.RNA: All13EMC retained; primary9 and all12primary and all13 shown. Compare to all primary malignant nonEMC and each MLPS/LGFMS/MFS primary group separately. Use existing specimen inclusion metadata; no pooled cross-study tests.
prospective_analysis.array: Every GSE24369 EMC (6), all original comparator groups and both normal muscle pools. Original Entrez-compatible probes; keep per-probe values, median unique-gene probes only. No cutoff optimized from expression.
prospective_analysis.uncertainty: A=Pr(EMC>comparator)+half ties, median differences and two-sided MannWhitney; 2000 bootstrap draws for A with seed20261004. Multiplicity report BH over all three genes across four plannedRNAcontrasts and separately over threegenes across two plannedarraymyxoidcontrasts. No nonsignificant-result-as-equivalence inference.
prospective_analysis.decision: A source mismatch alone establishes a provenance limitation, not a biological negative. A new useful disease finding requires measured evidence changing the lineage interpretation, complete relevantEMCevidence, priorart and independent value review. If only accession provenance is resolved, preserve audit without labelling it a new EMC discovery.

scope_limits: No author/journal contact or external scientific record edits
Retain all original hypotheses and earlierpilotresults
stopping: One targeted identity and expression batch, followed by independent reassessment. No fullpaperdraft. Accessible olderEMCsourceexpression or originalsourcecrosswalk stillpending blocksmanuscriptadvancement.
